hook.text: In 2009, footprints from 1.5 million years ago were found at Ileret, Kenya—almost identical to modern ones.

buildup.text: The prints show a pronounced arch, adducted big toe, and weight transfer pattern matching Homo sapiens.

discovery.text: These Homo erectus prints confirm that by 1.5 million years ago, the modern foot was fully evolved.

twist.text: Between Laetoli (3.6M) and Ileret (1.5M), the foot transformed from grasping to rigid—2 million years.

climax.text: Two sets of footprints, separated by 2 million years, bookend one of evolution's greatest changes.

punchline.text: The story of walking, written in footsteps.

quiz.question: What did the Ileret footprints show?
options: A fully modern foot by 1.5 million years ago
